hero.subtitle: CoopData centralizes registration, financial reporting, audit and analytics for every SACCO, agricultural union, federation and savings group — in one transparent, accountable platform.

mission.title: Transparent oversight for a thriving cooperative economy.
mission.trustBody: Cryptographically auditable submissions and full role-based access — every action is logged.
mission.evidenceBody: Regulators see real-time membership, capital and compliance data across all sectors.
mission.inclusiveBody: Multi-language interfaces, offline data capture and tablet-first workflows for field officers.
mission.govtBody: MFA, device management, WCAG accessibility, and resilient national-scale infrastructure.

sectors.title: Every cooperative, one registry.
sectors.subtitle: CoopData supports the full lifecycle of every recognized cooperative structure under national law — from registration through dissolution.

capabilities.title: A national-scale operating system for the cooperative sector.
capabilities.rbacBody: From ministry officials to field officers — every action permissioned and auditable.
capabilities.dataBody: No-code dynamic questionnaires with conditional logic, validation and approval workflows.
capabilities.offlineBody: Progressive Web App with background sync and conflict resolution for tablet field officers.
capabilities.reportingBody: Schedule, export and distribute PDF, XLSX, CSV and DOCX reports across the federation network.
capabilities.analyticsBody: Drill-down dashboards, geographic heatmaps, gender and youth indices, time comparisons.
capabilities.securityBody: MFA, session management, device control, full audit timeline and access logs.

faq.title: Frequently asked.
faq.a1: Any cooperative recognized under the Cooperative Societies Act may be registered by an authorized federation officer or ministry official.
faq.a2: Yes — field officers can capture data through the Progressive Web App and synchronize automatically when connectivity is restored.
faq.a3: CoopData ships with English, SiSwati and Portuguese interfaces. Additional languages are added on request.
faq.q4: How is my cooperative data protected?
faq.a4: All data is encrypted in transit and at rest, with role-based access, multi-factor authentication and full audit logging.

insights.message: Your {{displayName}} is {{coopVal}}, {{pctDiff}}% {{direction}} the sector average of {{benchVal}}.

par30.above: Portfolio delinquency is elevated. Consider strengthening loan recovery and tightening credit assessment.
par30.below: Strong portfolio quality — your delinquency rate is well managed.

par90.above: Non-performing loans are above sector average. Review write-off policies and recovery strategies.
par90.below: Non-performing loan ratio is well controlled.

capital_adequacy_ratio.above: Well-capitalised with a solid buffer against unexpected losses.
capital_adequacy_ratio.below: Capital buffer is thin. Consider retaining more surplus before dividend distribution.

liquid_funds_ratio.above: Strong liquidity position — member withdrawal obligations are well covered.
liquid_funds_ratio.below: Low liquidity may affect your ability to meet member withdrawals promptly.

roa.above: Above-average asset profitability — efficient use of resources.
roa.below: Review operating costs or loan pricing to improve returns on assets.

roe.below: Equity returns are below sector peers. Review pricing and cost efficiency.

operating_expense_ratio.above: Operating costs are low relative to assets — good cost discipline.
operating_expense_ratio.below: Operating expenses are high relative to assets. Identify efficiency opportunities.

operational_self_sufficiency.above: Financially self-sufficient — income covers all operating costs.
operational_self_sufficiency.below: Operating expenses exceed income. Review cost structures urgently.

loan_loss_coverage.above: Loan loss provisions adequately cover at-risk loans.
loan_loss_coverage.below: Provisions may be insufficient relative to loans in arrears. Consider increasing reserves.

default.above: Your performance is above sector average.
default.below: Your performance is below sector average. Review relevant processes.

TOTAL_MISMATCH.what: The sum of the sub-category line items does not add up to the reported total. This usually means some line items were mapped to the wrong account code, or key accounts are missing.
TOTAL_MISMATCH.fix: Check each line item in the table. Look for rows with 'Low' confidence — they are likely mapped to the wrong code. Use the account code dropdown to reassign them correctly. After fixing, click Re-validate.

BALANCE_UNBALANCED.what: Total Assets ≠ Total Liabilities + Total Equity. The fundamental accounting equation is broken.
BALANCE_UNBALANCED.fix: This usually means one or more totals are mapped incorrectly. Verify that code 1999 holds Total Assets, 2999 holds Total Liabilities, and 3999 holds Total Equity. Reassign any misplaced items.

MISSING_ACCOUNT.what: A required account code is missing from the extracted data. The AI could not find or confidently map this field from your document.
MISSING_ACCOUNT.fix: Scroll to the 'Unmapped Items' section at the bottom of the table. Find the item that corresponds to this account and use the 'Assign ↑' dropdown to assign the correct code.

LIQUIDITY_CRISIS.what: Liquid assets (cash + short-term investments) cover less than 50% of short-term liabilities. This is a critical risk indicator.
LIQUIDITY_CRISIS.fix: Verify that liquid asset codes (1101, 1102, 1103, 1104) and deposit codes (2101, 2102, 2103) are correctly assigned. If the values look right, this is a genuine financial risk requiring management attention.

LOW_LIQUIDITY.what: Liquid assets are below 10% of total assets. Either cash/investments are underreported or the cooperative has very little liquid resources.
LOW_LIQUIDITY.fix: Check that all cash accounts (1101, 1102, 1103) and short-term investments (1104) have been correctly identified and mapped. Look for any cash items in the unmapped section.

CASH_TOO_LOW.what: Cash on hand and at bank is below 2% of total assets, which is dangerously low for daily operations.
CASH_TOO_LOW.fix: Verify codes 1101 (Cash on Hand), 1102 (Cash at Bank Current), 1103 (Cash at Bank Savings) are correctly mapped with the right values.

NPL_HIGH.what: Non-performing loans exceed 10% of the total loan portfolio. This is above the alert threshold.
NPL_HIGH.fix: Verify codes 1201–1205 are correctly assigned to the right loan quality buckets. If the data is correct, this reflects a real credit risk requiring management action.

UNDER_PROVISIONING.what: The specific loan loss provision (code 1252) covers less than 50% of non-performing loans (code 1205). This may be a regulatory violation.
UNDER_PROVISIONING.fix: Check that 1252 (Specific Loan Loss Provision) is mapped and stored as a NEGATIVE number. Also verify 1205 (Non-Performing Loans) is correct.

LOW_EQUITY.what: Equity is below 10% of total assets. The cooperative may be under-capitalised.
LOW_EQUITY.fix: Verify that all equity components are mapped: 3101 (Permanent Share Capital), 3102 (Withdrawable Shares), 3201 (Statutory Reserve), 3301 (Accumulated Surplus), 3302 (Current Year Surplus).

STATUTORY_RESERVE_MISSING.what: The statutory reserve (code 3201) is zero or missing. This is legally required for cooperatives.
STATUTORY_RESERVE_MISSING.fix: Check if the uploaded document includes a statutory or legal reserve. If it does, find it in the unmapped items and assign code 3201.

HIGH_LEVERAGE.what: The debt-to-equity ratio exceeds the 2:1 target threshold.
HIGH_LEVERAGE.fix: Verify total liabilities (2999) and total equity (3999) are correctly mapped. If the data is accurate, this is a genuine financial concern.

LOW_PROFITABILITY.what: Return on Assets (ROA) is below 1%. The cooperative is generating very little profit relative to its asset base.
LOW_PROFITABILITY.fix: Verify income accounts (4101, 4102, 4201) and expense accounts (5101–5301) are all correctly mapped and that the current year surplus (3302) is present.

MISSING_DATA.what: A critical field that is required for financial analysis is missing from the extracted data.
MISSING_DATA.fix: Check the unmapped items section at the bottom of the table. The field may have been extracted but not assigned a code. Use the dropdown to assign the correct account code.

DEFAULT.what: A data quality or financial health issue was detected.
DEFAULT.fix: Review the flagged value, check for misassigned account codes, and click Re-validate after making corrections.

explanations.1101: Physical cash held in vaults, safes, and cash drawers.
explanations.1102: Checking account balances held at commercial banks, immediately withdrawable.
explanations.1103: Interest-bearing deposit account balances held at commercial banks.
explanations.1104: Liquid financial assets maturing within one year, such as treasury bills or money market funds.
explanations.1201: Outstanding principal balance of loans with regular repayments (0 days in arrears).
explanations.1202: Loans where repayment is overdue between 1 and 30 days.
explanations.1203: Loans where repayment is overdue between 31 and 60 days.
explanations.1204: Loans where repayment is overdue between 61 and 90 days.
explanations.1205: Impaired loans where repayment is overdue by more than 90 days.
explanations.1251: Estimated allowance for potential loan losses across the general performing portfolio.
explanations.1252: Allowance set aside for identified high-risk or non-performing loans.
explanations.1301: Amounts owed to the cooperative by members or clients for goods/services delivered.
explanations.1302: Advance payments made for expenses that will be incurred in future periods.
explanations.1303: Capitalized cost of physical infrastructure, machinery, and equipment.
explanations.1304: Total wear and tear written off against fixed assets over their lifetime.
explanations.1305: Non-physical valuable assets like proprietary software licenses, trademarks, or patents.
explanations.2101: Savings deposited by members that can be withdrawn at any time.
explanations.2102: Compulsory member contributions required for cooperative membership or loan access.
explanations.2103: Deposits held for a fixed duration at a locked interest rate with withdrawal restrictions.
explanations.2201: Loans or credit lines payable by the cooperative within one year.
explanations.2202: Debt obligations maturing in more than one year.
explanations.2301: Outstanding payments owed to suppliers or vendors for goods and services.
explanations.2302: Accumulated liabilities for expenses incurred but not yet invoiced (e.g. unpaid taxes, utilities).
explanations.2303: Unearned revenue received in advance of providing services or goods.
explanations.3101: Non-withdrawable equity capital contributed by members as ownership stake.
explanations.3102: Member shares that can be redeemed or withdrawn upon membership termination.
explanations.3201: Mandatory legal reserve funded from annual surplus as required by regulations.
explanations.3202: Discretionary reserve set aside from surplus for general cooperative growth and security.
explanations.3203: Reserves dedicated to meeting regulatory capital adequacy and risk coverage ratios.
explanations.3301: Retained earnings from prior fiscal years.
explanations.3302: Net earnings or surplus generated during the current reporting period.
explanations.4101: Revenue generated from interest charged on member loans.
explanations.4102: Revenue from application fees, service fees, or commissions.
explanations.4201: Non-core revenue like dividends, rental income, or asset sales.
explanations.5101: Interest payouts paid to members on voluntary, mandatory, or term deposits.
explanations.5102: Interest payments paid to external financial institutions on borrowings.
explanations.5201: Staff wages, salaries, allowances, and social security contributions.
explanations.5202: Office rent, utilities, insurance, stationery, and other daily running costs.
explanations.5203: Costs associated with board meetings, AGM, committee member fees, and audits.
explanations.5204: Annual depreciation expense written off against fixed and intangible assets.
explanations.5301: Annual P&L expense charge to fund the loan loss provision allowance.

membership.name: Membership Database
membership.description: Member roster with demographics, status, and participation

savings.name: Savings Database
savings.description: Savings accounts, balances, and contribution patterns

fixed-deposit.name: Fixed Deposit Database
fixed-deposit.description: Term deposits, maturity dates, and renewal status

loans.name: Loans Database
loans.description: Loan portfolio, repayment status, and risk indicators

membership.1: Gender must be Male, Female, or Other
membership.3: Status must be Active, Dormant, or Exited
membership.4: Join Date must be a valid date

savings.1: Member ID must reference a valid member
savings.2: Account Type must be Voluntary, Mandatory, or Fixed
savings.3: Balance must be a non-negative number
savings.4: Last Contribution must be a valid date

fixed-deposit.1: Member ID must reference a valid member
fixed-deposit.2: Deposit Type must be Short-term, Medium-term, or Long-term
fixed-deposit.3: Maturity Date must be after Start Date
fixed-deposit.4: Interest Rate must be a positive number

loans.1: Member ID must reference a valid member
loans.2: Status must be Performing, Arrears, Restructured, or Written Off
loans.3: Balance must not exceed Loan Amount
loans.4: Days Past Due must be a non-negative integer

multi-purpose.1: Member ID must reference a valid member
multi-purpose.2: Program Type must be a recognized category
multi-purpose.3: Disbursed Amount must not exceed Loan Amount
multi-purpose.4: Season must be a valid format (e.g., 2025/26)
